climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Lodi sub-AVA in Sacramento County, about 21 miles southeast of Sacramento, covering 78,800 acres. It is one of seven smaller areas carved from the Lodi AVA in 2006. The surrounding county grows mostly Chardonnay, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot.
